scope_decisions.rationale: Explicit rupture and extent branches cover ascending disease with/without arch extension and descending disease with rupture; the residual described descending pattern receives an anatomy/complication-based decision branch. Existing14 sections provide applicable emergency actions, recovery, medication, diet, surveillance and prevention, without implying all anatomies have identical procedures. Source-defined intramural haematoma/penetrating ulcer remain distinct; not used to expand unrelated ICD categories.
